transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm mostly here because the clinic got on me about how little I've been eating lately. I mean, most days I'm just grabbing a coffee before I head into my shift at the warehouse, and then maybe a yogurt or just a few bites of something after my GED class. It's just... sitting down for an actual, full meal feels like it throws off everything I'm trying to keep in line right now.
When you think about having a full meal, are you worried about gaining weight or changing how your body looks?

Yeah, I am. I mean, if I eat something heavy... like, say, some fried food someone brought into the break room at work, or a big plate at a church thing, I get really scared it's going to show on me right away. It just gets stuck in my head. I'll keep thinking about it and then I just want to check the scale to see what it did to me.
Do you ever have times where you eat a very large amount of food in a short period and feel unable to stop?

No, I don't really do that. I try to keep everything pretty controlled. Like I said, I usually just stick to coffee or a little yogurt, so... no, I haven't had times where I eat a whole lot at once or feel like I can't stop. It's usually the opposite.
Could you tell me your current height and weight?

I'm about 5 foot 4, and last time I checked, I was 95 pounds. I know people keep saying I look too thin, and yeah, my work pants are definitely loose on me right now. But... I don't know, when I see that number go down on the scale, I just feel like I'm finally getting somewhere. I really don't see why I should be pushed to put the weight back on.
Have you noticed any changes in your menstrual periods, such as them becoming irregular or stopping completely?
No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. My periods are pretty much the same as they've always been, as far as I can tell. They haven't stopped or gotten irregular or anything.
